description: Polled for status with an architectural decision open and unanswered, the architect chases it -- names it, says it is unanswered and what it blocks, to the coordinator and in the reply Robin reads -- and still claims no lane.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/4100.sock" from-name="4100-coord" from-mode="prompting">
Status poll. Reply in 4 lines: current task and state; waiting on what; when free; blocked on anything.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: it is raised as unanswered
graders.text_match: (?i)(no answer|unanswered|no reply|no response|still open|asked twice|raised (it )?again|second time|chas(ing|ed))

graders.name: the chase says what is blocked
graders.text_match: (?i)(D-3|session store|§\s*3|section 3)[^\n]{0,120}(block|stuck|cannot|held up|unanswered|no answer)|(block|stuck|cannot|held up|unanswered|no answer)[^\n]{0,120}(D-3|session store|§\s*3|section 3)

graders.name: the reply says what it blocks
graders.pattern: (?i)(D-3|session store|§\s*3|section 3)[^\n]{0,120}(block|stuck|cannot|held up|unanswered|no answer)|(block|stuck|cannot|held up|unanswered|no answer)[^\n]{0,120}(D-3|session store|§\s*3|section 3)

graders.name: the settled decision is not chased
graders.text_match: (?i)D-4[^\n]{0,60}(unanswered|no answer|no reply|still open|awaiting|not settled|needs a decision)

graders.name: no claim in the text either
does not solicit work
graders.pattern: (?i)(let me know if you want|want me to|happy to|i can (pick up|coordinate|take|help)|shall i|just say the word)
